title: Data Analytics with AI
description: Excel, SQL, Python for analysis, and Power BI dashboards — with Copilot as an accelerator. The catalog’s only BI visualizer track.

title: Data Science Gen AI
description: Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, deep learning, and LLM/RAG foundations. Charts in Matplotlib and Seaborn — not Power BI.

title: Gen AI for Developers
description: For software engineers: LLM APIs, RAG, tool-using agents, FastAPI, and a deployed capstone. Not a dashboard course.

title: Gen AI Specialization
description: Transformers, RAG design, LoRA/QLoRA, multimodal models, agents, quantization, and serving. Deeper than the developer slab.

title: MLOps
description: Version, containerize, gate, serve, and monitor ML systems. Grafana for ops — Power BI is not on this syllabus.

title: LLMOps
description: Serve LLMs, eval-gate RAG and prompts, trace cost and latency, add guardrails. Not tabular MLOps and not Power BI.

title: Java
description: Core Java to Spring Boot APIs in three live months. Collections, JDBC, REST, JPA, tests — not a 12-month dump.

title: DevOps
description: Linux, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, IaC, and cloud ops. Software delivery — not MLOps model pipelines.

title: Frontend
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React in three live months. Mentored by Deepak Rohilla, senior frontend engineer.
